results.name: P5 the slots on the screen are exactly the backend's slots of the restaurant-local day (28 today), each shown on the restaurant clock
P6 tapping a slot sends its KEY (a mode, a key, the method, the cart version — never a timestamp); the backend answers with the slot it stored and the screen marks that slot as chosen
P7 RETRY WITHOUT A SECOND CHOICE: the answer to the tap is lost; the app asks once more with the SAME idempotency key and the backend answers the stored result — the choice was applied once

P8 CAPACITY from the Restaurant Dashboard (2 orders per slot): the app shows the backend's state — the taken slot "Full" and not tappable, the one with its last place "Limited"; no number of places anywhere

P9 a full slot sends nothing when tapped; A SLOT THAT FILLS UP WHILE THE CUSTOMER LOOKS is refused by the backend (409 slot_full) — the app says so in the backend's words, asks for the times again and shows the slot as Full; the earlier choice is untouched
results.detail: 409 {"error":{"code":"slot_full","message":"That pickup time is no longer available. Please select another time.","request_i notice true

results.name: P10 THE RESTAURANT PAUSES ORDERS (dashboard): the app shows the backend's reason, offers no time, marks the stored choice as no longer valid and keeps Continue off
P11 ON RESUME the app asks the backend again without being told to: back from the background the times are offered again (the restaurant accepts orders again) and the stored choice is valid again

P12 NO CONNECTION: the app says "Needs connection to confirm availability", shows the last known selection as exactly that, offers no times from memory and keeps Continue OFF — an old slot is never taken for valid
P13 back online, "Try again" asks the backend: the notice is gone, the choice is confirmed by the backend and Continue is available again
P14 APP RESTART: the choice comes back from the backend with the cart (the guest token is in the device's secure storage) — the same slot

results.name: P15 SIGN-IN KEEPS THE PICKUP CHOICE: the guest cart becomes the customer's and the chosen slot is still there; pickup requests now carry the session and no cart token

P16a a journey that has no arrival estimate for this restaurant (the cart was linked to it without coming from route discovery) is shown as exactly that — no arrival is invented; the times follow the restaurant schedule

P16b JOURNEY-AWARE: with an arrival 40 minutes ahead the backend reads it from the cart's journey; the app shows "Your estimated arrival" on the restaurant clock, labelled as a development estimate, and marks the backend's recommended time — the first slot that is ready and not before the arrival

P17 PREPARATION TIME 12 → 50 in the dashboard: the app shows "Estimated preparation 50 min", the earliest slot chosen before can no longer be met — the backend's warning is shown and Continue is off until another time is chosen
P18 the prep time is back: the same choice is valid again; "Continue to checkout" has the backend judge it once more and then opens checkout (checkout itself is still development data — Module 29)
